swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB uses SOT-23-3 (3-pin, DBZ (SOT-23-3)) while TPS7A0233PDBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV (SOT-23-5)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Soldering TPS7A0233PDBVR onto a LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 0.1 µF p.11 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 1 µF p.5); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A0233PDBVR is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB at 30 V rec. (35 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 100 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A0233PDBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 900 mV p.5 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 270 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS7A0233PDBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.4) than LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (35 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 48% higher on LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 269.6 °C/W p.4 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 181.9 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.5) vs 1.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-3) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 100 mA (170 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 45.8 °C on LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (θJA 269.6 °C/W) vs 30.9 °C on TPS7A0233PDBVR (θJA 181.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 80000x ratio (2000 µA (p.5) vs 0.025 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB "Unique SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND) Incompatible With ALL Other SOT-23-3 LDOs in Batch" (p.3) and TPS7A0233PDBVR "Strict 22 uF Maximum Output Capacitance Limit for Loop Stability" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 30 V); choose TPS7A0233PDBVR when load current exceeds 100 mA (up to 200 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 0.025 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
